entities.name: Mount Delapre
entities.description: High snow-covered peak in the Karplusan Mountains on Terisiare, along the Balesh Pass.

entities.name: Balesh Pass
entities.description: Pass along which Mount Delapre lies.

entities.name: Mount Kireshal
entities.description: Peak a two-days walk from Mount Delapre.

entities.name: Groth Jonar
entities.description: Balduvian orc general who ordered goblins of the Flarg to hide along Mount Delapre.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: Goblin troops assigned to Groth Jonar; they died flanking the Kjeldoran knights.

entities.name: Kjeldoran knights
entities.description: Enemy force flanked by the goblins.

entities.name: Second battle of Balesh Pass
entities.description: Battle in which the goblins' ambush brought victory.

events.summary: Groth Jonar ordered the Flarg goblins to hide in the snow on Mount Delapre; they flanked the Kjeldoran knights and won at the cost of their lives.
events.quote: the goblins helped flank the Kjeldoran knights , leading to a victory, though at the cost of the goblins' lives

relations.quote: Mount Delapre was a high peak in the Karplusan Mountains
